nodes.title: Grover's Search and Quadratic Speedup
nodes.conceptSummary: Grover's algorithm searches an unstructured database of $N$ items in $O(\sqrt{N})$ operations by repeatedly applying the Grover diffusion operator. Inverting target phase followed by reflection about the mean geometrically amplifies the target state amplitude.
